background.scope: same-symbol same-side continuous-valid supplied-window union; all best prices; not historical VolQuant

config.directional_truth: unavailable; C_quote is supplied quote-loss proxy, not independent directional trades
config.selection: all maximal observed same-price pieces, including singletons; plus strongest interval per piece/width/entry; no future outcome selection
config.scan: every valid row as endpoint; trailing 2/10/30s clipped to piece start; per-width populations may overlap; retained identical intervals deduplicated across widths; whole piece also evaluated
config.future: generic fixed horizons 10/30/60s stored separately; never used by entry/representative selection; no S04 comparisons
config.sensitivity: same retrievals at loose/base/strict; not optimized against future price or reserved cases

restrictions: C_quote/r/c/n are quote-derived descriptive research metrics; independent directional truth unavailable
large quote uses causal local prior-window relative background only; formal historical VolQuant unavailable
display refs are temporal/side context; wall also requires price-band match; exact formal feature identity/history unavailable
no formal Wall absence truth: missing display is unknown
all metrics are from selective supplied windows; candidate/piece counts are not market prevalence or independent process counts
all reserved samples remain generic program scanning only; no detailed case/hypothesis selection
S04-S09 not executed; post-period measurements not used for retrieval or hypothesis formation
interval_count_note: per-width interval populations include identical intervals across widths; overlap table is per width; retained table deduplicates interval keys; unique maximal pieces are separate population
